title: Change dollars into rand
source: Theory IGCSE-13.5 Quick check 1 ($75 at $1=4 rand gives 300 rand); book Worked example 9 style p.421, new numbers
stem: The exchange rate is \(1\) dollar \(=4\) rand. Change \(({d|int})\) dollars into rand.

steps.name: A
steps.note: Multiply by the rate when changing from the currency written as 1.

title: Change dollars into euros
source: Theory IGCSE-13.5 Quick check 2 ($500 at 1 euro=$1.25 gives 400 euros); book style pp.422-425, new numbers
stem: The exchange rate is \(1\) euro \(=1.25\) dollars. Change \(({d|int})\) dollars into euros.

steps.name: A
steps.text_tex: \(1\) euro \(=1.25\) dollars, so to change dollars into euros, divide by \(1.25\). \( {d|int}\div 1.25={E|int}\) euros
steps.note: Divide when changing into the currency written as 1.

title: Change yen into pounds
source: Theory IGCSE-13.5 Quick check 3 (4800 yen at £1=160 yen gives 30 pounds); book style pp.422-425, new numbers
stem: The exchange rate is \(£1=160\) yen. Change \(({n|int})\) yen into pounds.

steps.name: A
steps.text_tex: \(£1=160\) yen, so to change yen into pounds, divide by \(160\). \( {n|int}\div 160={P|int}\) pounds

title: Change euros into dollars at a given exchange rate

source.note: Stem taken from the QP PDF (UCLES 2021), Question 5. Official answer and mark allocation from the MS PDF. The item is paper/self-mark.

stem:
This question is 0580/23/O/N/21 Question 5, taken from the official QP.

Nina changes 153 euros into dollars when the exchange rate is $1 = 0.9 euros.

Calculate the amount Nina receives.

steps.name: A
steps.text_tex: The rate is 1 dollar \(=0.9\) euros, so the number of dollars is \(153\div 0.9=170\).
